# BackOfficeFleet instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow AGENTS.md. In particular, the content preservation directive applies to Copilot:

No AI agent may remove, abbreviate, simplify, replace, or materially diminish previously approved BOF
content, functionality, imagery, or workflows without explicit owner authorization.

See docs/governance/CONTENT-PRESERVATION-POLICY.md and docs/governance/superseded-decisions.md, and run
`npm run check:preservation` before proposing changes to public pages, demos or recovered content.
